acceptanceCriteria: work_item_compatibility detects exact, wildcard, nested glob, and separator-normalized scope overlaps conservatively
src/** and src/main.rs, src/** and src/test/**, and Windows separator variants cannot be reported compatible
scope patterns that cannot be proven disjoint fail closed with scope_overlap_unknown
regression tests cover disjoint scopes, exact overlap, nested glob overlap, Windows separators, and conservative unknown handling
reader-facing command or capability documentation describes conservative parallel scope compatibility
goal: Prevent parallel Work Items with overlapping or uncertain repository scopes from being reported compatible.
intent: Fix the repository-local Work Item compatibility check so scope overlap is detected conservatively across exact paths, nested globs, and path separators.
outOfScope: changing Work Item identity or repository context semantics
changing verification scheduler execution or resource budgets
adding a dependency for a full glob engine
changing global Agent or MCP configuration
rewriting historical Work Item or release evidence
